scope: Per-item admission/disposition for the 13 source-only host methods. No engine duplication; enabled-vs-unavailable is published explicitly.
decision: All 13 remain EXPLICITLY UNAVAILABLE in this milestone. They stay in the declared runtime vocabulary because the reintegration contract + api-coverage pin the full source-method list, but they are no longer advertised to the model, and every direct/forged call is rejected by Main before any browser effect.

advertisement.mechanism: openclaw_runtime/src/agents/tools/agent-browser-tool.ts exports DRIVER_UNAVAILABLE_ACTIONS and defaults the TypeBox action enum to the declared list minus that set; a primed capability snapshot still narrows it further.
advertisement.driftGuard: tests/unit/versebrowser-n5-source-only-disposition.test.ts asserts the set equals the live capability snapshot's unavailable set.

rejection.surface: Main adapter withCapabilityGate (renderer IPC) and the Gateway bridge assertActionAvailable
rejection.envelope: host-invoke maps E_CAPABILITY_UNAVAILABLE to the UNSUPPORTED envelope code
